name: Cripple Creek stage at Grassy, Midland Terminal Railway
basis: Catalogue record of the holding library, read on 2026-11-24.
notes: Glass negative. The library: 'Cripple Creek stagecoach "no. 7 US Mail" with driver holding the reins of a team of horses, Midland Railway engine and car "22", terminal building, telephone poles, and hills.' The best view found of the railway at Grassy. Which way it looks has not been worked out.

name: Six horse stage at Grassy Depot, Midland Terminal

The library's date range starts before the railway.

name: Cameron, Colorado
basis: Catalogue record of the holding library, read on 2026-11-24.
notes: The library: 'Cows graze in a field near a fence; a long narrow gabled building is across the fence. The town of Cameron is in the background at the foot of the hills that surround the valley.' A copy negative from the programme of the Trans-Mississippi Commercial Congress (Cripple Creek, July 1901), so the copy may carry that book's printed caption: crop to the photograph before showing.

name: View of Pinnacle Park in Cripple Creek district
basis: Catalogue record of the holding library, read on 2026-11-24.

name: Pinnacle Park (footbridge over the tracks)
basis: Catalogue record of the holding library, read on 2026-11-24.
notes: The library: 'Railroad tracks running under ornate footbridge with wire fence alongside ... Two warmly dressed women are seated on a rock in the mid-ground.'
